landingLine: Mike Moncada is inviting you to a Christmas party!
landingSubline: But only the worthy get the details!
howToPlay: Your teammate keeps setting you the ball. You jump on your own.
Swipe up when the ring turns gold at the top of the jump.
Swipe up-left, straight up (or tap), or up-right to pick a lane. Spike the snowmen before they waddle in for a hug.
privacyNote: No ads. No tracking. The only information collected is what you type in the RSVP, if you choose to send it.
cookieContestNote: Optional cookie contest! Must be homemade and Christmas themed.
